about.title: About Know Your Wait
about.intro: Know Your Wait is a free, independent, open-source website that explains official NHS waiting-time statistics for England, Wales and Scotland in plain English.
about.purposeBody: NHS waiting-time statistics are public, but spread across separate government and NHS websites in each nation. They are usually presented for administrative performance reporting rather than for patients. Know Your Wait republishes official figures with clear explanations so people referred for planned NHS care can understand what the figures mean and what patient rights apply to them.
about.principleNeverCompare: Never compare across nations: each publishing nation's figures are shown separately under its own definitions and rules.
about.principleSnapshots: Snapshots, not predictions: figures describe people already on waiting lists at a specific reporting period, never an individual forecast.
about.principleExactOnly: Official or exact sums only: we republish official figures as released by official bodies, or exact sums of published bands. We never estimate or interpolate.
about.principleNoRanking: No ranking or nudging: we never sort hospital trusts or health boards by waiting time.
about.principleIndependent: Independent: we are completely independent of the NHS and government. We do not sell healthcare, private insurance, or referrals.
about.openSourceBody: The entire project is open source. You can inspect our code, data pipeline, and normalised data in our public repository.
about.dataLink: Browse normalised data directory on GitHub
about.contactBody: Have feedback, questions, or spotted an issue? Email us at {email}.

sources.title: Sources and licences
sources.intro: Know Your Wait republishes official statistics released under the UK Open Government Licence (OGL v3.0). All figures shown on this site are either Official Figures or Derived Figures.
sources.officialFiguresDef: An Official Figure is a statistic republished unchanged from an official publishing nation release, always shown with its source, reporting period and publication date.
sources.derivedFiguresDef: A Derived Figure is calculated by Know Your Wait by exactly adding official figure bands from the same release (for example, summing published waiting bands). If any input figure is withheld or suppressed, the derived figure is not produced. We never estimate, interpolate or fill gaps.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Know Your Wait is built to respect your privacy. We collect no personal information and use no tracking cookies.
privacy.analyticsBody: We use Cloudflare Web Analytics to measure site traffic and aggregate page views. Cloudflare Web Analytics is privacy-first: it does not use cookies, does not collect personal data, does not track you across other websites, and does not build visitor profiles.
privacy.noAccountsBody: Know Your Wait does not have user accounts, logins, or tracking identifiers. You do not need to register or provide any information to view waiting-time figures.
privacy.contactBody: If you contact us by email at {email}, we use your email address only to reply to your message. We do not share your contact details or use them for marketing.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.intro: Know Your Wait is designed to be accessible to everyone. We aim to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA standard.
accessibility.standardsListSemantic: Semantic HTML: pages use standard landmarks, headings, and semantic elements for screen readers.
accessibility.standardsListNoJs: Works without JavaScript: all content, national waiting statistics, and navigation are fully accessible without client-side JavaScript enabled.
accessibility.standardsListKeyboard: Keyboard navigation: all links and interactive controls can be accessed and operated using a keyboard with visible focus indicators.
accessibility.standardsListContrast: Clear contrast and typography: text meets or exceeds WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements.
accessibility.feedbackBody: We continually test our site with automated and manual accessibility checks. If you experience any accessibility issues or barriers, please let us know by emailing {email} or opening an issue on GitHub.
accessibility.feedbackLink: Report an accessibility issue on GitHub
